## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for this change
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` passes (required if UI, page-agent or fill logic changed)
- [ ] Privacy rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/CarlosLeonCode/answeronce/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#privacy-rules-non-negotiable) respected: no backend, no analytics, no personal data in browser storage, consent fields never filled, agents never read `settings.json`
- [ ] No real personal data, CVs or API keys in code, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] Docs updated (README, CONTRIBUTING) if behavior, scripts or permissions changed
- [ ] Commits follow conventional commits
- [ ] I signed the [CLA](https://github.com/CarlosLeonCode/answeronce/blob/main/CLA.md) (the bot asks on your first PR)
